evidence: The solution opens with two equalities that are both untrue, then abandons them mid-sentence with an ellipsis before reaching the correct factorisation. It claims \(1+x+\sqrt{x+x^2}=(\sqrt{x})^2+(\sqrt{1+x})^2+\sqrt{x}\sqrt{1+x}\), but that right-hand side is \(x+(1+x)+\sqrt{x+x^2}=1+2x+\sqrt{x+x^2}\) — it exceeds the numerator by \(x\), so the two agree only at \(x=0\). It then restates the same wrong quantity as \((\sqrt{x}+\sqrt{1+x})^2-\sqrt{x}\sqrt{1+x}\), which expands to \(1+2x+\sqrt{x+x^2}\) as well — internally consistent with the first false line, and equally not the numerator. Only the third claim, that the numerator is \((\sqrt{x}+\sqrt{1+x})\sqrt{x+1}\), is correct: \((\sqrt{x}+\sqrt{1+x})\sqrt{1+x}=\sqrt{x+x^2}+(1+x)\). The final answer B is right; the printed route to it opens with two false lines of abandoned scratch work.
